Overview of the Speculation

Actor Jack Lowden has addressed ongoing media reports linking him to the iconic role of James Bond. Speaking in a recent interview with British GQ, the Scottish actor acknowledged the speculation surrounding upcoming films from Amazon MGM Studios but declined to feed further rumors.

Reports have circulated naming various actors as potential successors to Daniel Craig. However, official confirmation regarding casting decisions or finalized screen tests has not been provided by the studio.

What Is Confirmed and Unconfirmed

  • Confirmed: Jack Lowden spoke with British GQ about the flattering nature of being mentioned in connection with major roles.
  • Confirmed: Lowden stated he prefers not to add to the ongoing media noise surrounding the franchise.
  • Unconfirmed: Any official casting choice for the next James Bond film remains unverified by studio representatives.
